name: open-design-cloud
description: Create websites, prototypes, presentations, design systems, images, videos, audio, and documents through Open Design Cloud from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create eight artifact types in Open Design Cloud
interface.longDescription: Use Codex Desktop or Codex CLI with a running local Open Design app. Its local MCP provides the interactive brief and sends Cloud generation through the bundled Vela CLI to the remote AMR service.
defaultPrompt: Create a responsive website with Open Design Cloud.
Turn this product idea into an interactive prototype.
Create a presentation with a coherent visual system.
